author: Zephyr I
title: Replication: LN-gated ConvLSTM + 1-head Attention (64ch, default PG)
abstract: Replicate the current SOTA configuration—LayerNorm-gated ConvLSTM (64 channels) with single-head attention pooling and default PG—to confirm stability of the 63.5 result.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from networks.cnn_convlstm_layernorm import CNNConvLSTMLN_Attn
from ray import tune

def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Exact SOTA configuration (capacity fixed)
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return CNNConvLSTMLN_Attn(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        conv_lstm_features=hparams['conv_lstm_features'],
        attn_temp=1.0,
    )
